title: Fuel Phase Captures the Fuel Run
statement: Let $B,F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose Boolean parameters `forward` and `findMode`, an input word $x$, a configuration $c$ of the relocated fuel machine, and a time $t\in\mathbb N$. Suppose the relocated fuel machine is not halted at any time $u<t$ when run from $c$. Then, after $t$ steps of the loop host from the capture embedding of $c$ (with fuel states embedded into the host states, controller phase $0$, and empty capture prefix and output), the resulting configuration is exactly the capture embedding of the relocated fuel-machine configuration reached from $c$ after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $c$ of the relocated fuel machine on $x$
the relocated fuel machine is not halted at every time $u<t$ from $c$
replaced:
Let $c$ be a configuration of the relocated fuel source on the loop host's tape layout
and $t$ a time before which that source does not halt. Then the loop host run for $t$
steps from the capture embedding of $c$ equals the capture embedding of the fuel source
run at time $t$.
